description_en: Releases contiguous elastic IP addresses (EIPs) by calling ReleaseEipSegmentAddress
kebab_example: aliyun vpc release-eip-segment-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --segment-instance-id eipsg-2zett8ba055tbsxme0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseEipSegmentAddress

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the contiguous EIPs. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 连续EIP所属的地域ID。可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the contiguous EIP group to release.

The system releases all EIPs in the contiguous EIP group
parameters.help_zh:
要释放的连续EIP组的实例ID。

系统会释放该连续EIP组内的所有EIP
parameters.name: segment_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
